title: BASELINE — General Health & SF-36
description: Self-rated health, activity limitation, mood and social-activity items from the baseline questionnaire, and the SF36 scores.

health1_bl.title: In general, would you say your health is:

yearAgo_bl.title: Compared to one year ago, how would you rate your health in general now?

vig_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: vigorous activities?

mod_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: moderate activities?

lift_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: lifting / carrying groceries?

stairA_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: climbing several flights of stairs?

stairB_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: climbing one flight of stairs?

bend_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: bending, kneeling, or stooping?

mile_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: walking more than one mile?

halfmile_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: walking half a mile?

walk_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: walking a few metres?

bath_bl.title: Does your health now limit you in the following activity: bathing / dressing?

phys_time_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you had to cut down on the time spent at work / on activities due to physical health?

phys_less_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you accomplished less at work / on other regular daily activities due to physical health?

phys_kind_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you been limited in the kind of work / regular daily activities due to physical health?

phys_diff_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you had difficulty in performing the work / regular daily activities due to physical health?

emo_time_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you had to cut down on the time spent at work / on activities due to emotional problems?

emo_less_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you accomplished less at work / on other regular daily activities due to emotional problems?

emo_care_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, have you accomplished work / other regular daily activities less carefully due to emotional problems?

social1_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, to what extent has your physical health or emotional problems interfered with your normal social activities?

pain1_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, how much bodily pain have you had?

pain2_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, how much did pain interfere with normal daily activities?

getUp_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Did you feel full of get up and go?

nervous_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Have you been a very nervous person?

down_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Have you felt so down that nothing could cheer you up?

calm_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Have you felt calm and peaceful?

energy_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Did you have a lot of energy?

sad_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Have you felt downhearted and sad?

worn_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Did you feel worn out?

happy_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Have you been a happy person?

tired_bl.title: How you feel and how things have been for you during the last 4 weeks: Did you feel tired?

social2_bl.title: During the past 4 weeks, how much of the time has your physical health or emotional problems interfered with your social activities?

sick_bl.title: I seem to get sick a little easier than other people

others_bl.title: I am as healthy as anybody I know

worse_bl.title: I expect my health to get worse

GH_NBS_bl.title: SF36 -- general health perceptions -  norm-based scoring
